ruleset.name: Apex Design Rules
ruleset.description: Custom rules for Apex design issues (structure, method signatures, class organization)

rule.name: DmlInLoopAcrossMethods
rule.message: DML operations should not be performed inside loops. The loop calls method '{0}' which performs DML operations. Collect records in a list and perform bulk DML outside the loop
rule.description:
DML operations should not be performed inside loops, even when the DML operation is in a separate method called from the loop. This pattern leads to governor limit issues and poor performance. Collect records in a list and perform bulk DML operations outside the loop instead.
This rule detects when a for loop or for-each loop calls a method that performs DML operations (insert, update, delete, upsert, merge, or Database class methods). The rule flags the loop that calls the method, not the method that performs the DML.
Version: 1.0.0

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $dmlMethods := //Method[ .//DmlInsertStatement or .//DmlUpdateStatement or .//DmlDeleteStatement or .//DmlUpsertStatement or .//DmlMergeStatement or .//MethodCallExpression[ ReferenceExpression[@Image = 'Database'] and (@MethodName = 'insert' or @MethodName = 'update' or @MethodName = 'delete' or @MethodName = 'upsert' or @MethodName = 'merge') ] ], $dmlMethodNames := $dmlMethods/@Image return //(ForLoopStatement | ForEachStatement)[ BlockStatement//MethodCallExpression[@MethodName = $dmlMethodNames] ]
